## Notes

MS-DOS November 1994, Chris Sawyer, MicroProse; Deluxe 1995; ports to PlayStation, Saturn, Android, iOS. Road, rail, sea, air; reliability and breakdowns; station catchment and ratings; delivery-time revenue; Local Authority ratings; up to seven AI rivals; influences Railroad Tycoon, A-Train, SimCity 2000, Theme Park; OpenTTD.
